# PromptBill

> LLM API token pricing comparator, 30-day API spend estimator, benchmark leaderboard, and model directory at https://promptbill.online.

PromptBill helps developers and AI engineering teams compare per-1M-token input, cached input, and output rates, model context windows, output throughput (tok/s), benchmark scores, and Score/$ value efficiency, with explicit Verified vs. Estimated provenance labels.

## Core Pages & Tools

- [Home & Spend Estimator](https://promptbill.online/): Overview, 30-day API cost calculator with caching and batch discounts, and core tools.
- [Models Directory & Workload Matcher](https://promptbill.online/models): Searchable model catalog, workload matcher, compact index vs. card views, and mobile/desktop pagination.
- [Benchmark Leaderboard](https://promptbill.online/leaderboard): Rank models by benchmark score, coding (CO), reasoning (RE), speed (tok/s), and Score/$ efficiency.
- [Head-to-Head Compare](https://promptbill.online/compare): Side-by-side comparison of two models across pricing, context window, speed, and benchmarks.
- [API Token Pricing](https://promptbill.online/pricing): Per-1M-token input, cached read, and output pricing table with provenance status.
- [LLM Selector](https://promptbill.online/tools/llm-selector): Filter models by task, budget, context window, and license.
- [Token Counter](https://promptbill.online/tools/token-counter): Estimate prompt tokens and per-request cost.
- [Routing Simulator](https://promptbill.online/tools/routing-simulator): Model hybrid routing cost savings simulator.
- [Methodology](https://promptbill.online/methodology): Pricing and benchmark provenance rules (Verified vs. Estimated vs. Unavailable).

## Tier & Use-Case Hubs

- [LLMs Under $1 / 1M Output Tokens](https://promptbill.online/tiers/under-1-dollar-per-1m): Budget and high-volume models under $1.00 per 1M output tokens.
- [Flagship & High-Score LLMs](https://promptbill.online/tiers/flagship-reasoning): High-benchmark models for reasoning and complex tasks.
- [Fastest LLMs (tok/s)](https://promptbill.online/tiers/high-throughput-speed): High-throughput models ranked by output tokens per second.
- [Best LLMs for Coding](https://promptbill.online/best-llms-for-coding): Coding-focused model rankings.
- [Best Open-Weight LLMs](https://promptbill.online/best-open-weight-llms): Open-weight model directory.
- [Cheapest LLMs for Classification](https://promptbill.online/cheapest-llms-for-classification): Low-cost classification models.
- [Fastest LLMs Tokens Per Second](https://promptbill.online/fastest-llms-tokens-per-second): Throughput rankings.
